super_bot_fight_mode.reason: Off until a check on staging shows it can be kept off the API's paths: it would challenge homes and native apps on api.maktaba.tv (story 50.30 §4). Turnstile guards the auth pages instead.

owasp.reason: Logs only for its first 14 days, so false positives (often on large JSON bodies) show in Security Events and get an exception before it blocks (story 50.30 rollout).

custom_rules.description: Admin paths only on the admin host
custom_rules.reason: The operator API is never served on a user name; the origin refuses it too (50.32), so a mistake in one place is caught by the other.

custom_rules.description: Admin host serves only its own paths
custom_rules.reason: admin.maktaba.tv answers the console's pages, the admin and staff API and health checks, nothing of the user API.
custom_rules.expression: http.host eq "admin.maktaba.tv" and not (starts_with(http.request.uri.path, "/v1/admin/") or starts_with(http.request.uri.path, "/v1/staff/") or http.request.uri.path in {"/healthz" "/readyz"} or not starts_with(http.request.uri.path, "/v1/"))

custom_rules.reason: TRACE, CONNECT and TRACK have no use on these names and are probes.
No sign-in, sign-up or reset body comes near 16 KB; a larger one is an attack on the parser or the hash.

rate_limits.reason: About four times what a person retyping a password sends, far below a credential-stuffing run; the API's per-account lockout stays behind it.
rate_limits.expression: http.request.method eq "POST" and (http.request.uri.path in {"/v1/auth/login" "/v1/auth/register" "/v1/auth/password/forgot" "/v1/auth/password/reset" "/v1/auth/verify-email/resend"} or (http.host eq "admin.maktaba.tv" and (http.request.uri.path in {"/v1/staff/login" "/v1/staff/reauth"} or starts_with(http.request.uri.path, "/v1/staff/mfa/"))))

rate_limits.reason: Generous: one public IP can carry a household or a carrier-grade NAT, and homes call the API every minute; the API's own per-account limits are tighter.
rate_limits.expression: http.host eq "api.maktaba.tv" or (http.host eq "app.maktaba.tv" and starts_with(http.request.uri.path, "/v1/"))

body.message: Too many requests. Wait a moment and try again.
